name: com.surveymonkey.surveymonkeyandroidsdk.SMFeedbackActivity
description: The SurveyMonkey Mobile Feedback SDK opens this Activity when the app starts an in-app feedback survey. It displays the supplied survey and returns the respondent's answers or a cancellation or error result to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot show its SurveyMonkey feedback form or receive the user's answers through this SDK.
